Object.Description: A dark, glowing artifact pulsing with unstable soul energy. Used beside the remains of a fallen Elder boss, still circled by its escaping souls, it raises that boss again in its Empowered form: stronger, faster and richer in loot.

EffectInfo.name: On use
EffectInfo.description: Raises a fallen Elder boss in its Empowered form (within 3 tiles)

EffectInfo.name: Broadside
EffectInfo.description: Every 6th hit, a cannonball bursts on the target for 3 times the hit to every enemy within 2 tiles

Object.Description: The Pirate King's blade, hauled up from the deep with him. It still drips seawater, and it still cuts. Dropped by the Empowered Dreadstump the Pirate King.

EffectInfo.name: Widow's Venom
EffectInfo.description: Hits build venom on an enemy; the 5th bursts it for 650 damage, ignoring defense

Object.Description: A fang of the Spider Queen raised from the dead. Its venom slows whatever it pierces. Dropped by the Empowered Arachna the Spider Queen.

EffectInfo.name: Serpent's Wind
EffectInfo.description: Using it gives +10 dexterity for 4 seconds

Object.Description: Mixcoatl's own quiver, its arrows fletched with the plumes of the feathered serpent. Dropped by the Empowered Mixcoatl the Masked God.

EffectInfo.name: Stone Gaze
EffectInfo.description: Hits on an enemy above 75% health deal half as much again, ignoring defense

Object.Description: Strung with the hair of a gorgon twice dead. Its arrows strike like her stare: heavy, and slowing. Dropped by the Empowered Stheno the Snake Queen.

EffectInfo.name: Soul Harvest
EffectInfo.description: Kills store souls (5 at most); using it bursts them at the target for 90 damage each and heals you 40 each

Object.Description: Septavius kept his soul in this skull. He has no more use for it; you do. Dropped by the Empowered Septavius the Ghost God.

EffectInfo.name: Phase
EffectInfo.description: Using it makes you untouchable for 1 second and speedy for 2 (every 8 seconds at most)

Object.Description: The light of a sprite god, bent back from the dead through a shard of crystal. Dropped by the Empowered Limon the Sprite God.

EffectInfo.name: Hellbrand
EffectInfo.description: Hits have a 15% chance to curse the enemy for 2 seconds: it takes more damage from everyone

Object.Description: Malphas burned souls to light his way out of the abyss. This staff still burns them, yours a little too. Dropped by the Empowered Archdemon Malphas.

EffectInfo.name: Bloodthirst
EffectInfo.description: Heals you 4% of the damage your shots deal, up to 40 health a second

Object.Description: Lord Ruthven's wand, carved from a bone of his first victim. It thirsts. Dropped by the Empowered Lord Ruthven.

EffectInfo.name: Masquerade
EffectInfo.description: When shot, a 20% chance to turn invisible and speedy for 2 seconds (every 10 seconds at most)

Object.Description: Worn for the last dance of a god twice dead. Nobody inside it stays still for long. Dropped by the Empowered Masked Party God.

EffectInfo.name: Davy's Bargain
EffectInfo.description: Below a quarter of your health, heals you half your health and makes you untouchable for 1.5 seconds (once a minute)

Object.Description: Davy Jones' signet, pulled from his finger in the locker. The sea gives back nothing for free. Dropped by the Empowered Davy Jones.

EffectInfo.name: Toxic Scales
EffectInfo.description: When shot, enemies within 3 tiles burn for 240 over 3 seconds (every 2 seconds at most)

Object.Description: Hide of Limoz, risen and slain again. The venom in its scales keeps its wearer's wounds clean. Dropped by the Empowered Limoz the Veridian Dragon.

EffectInfo.name: Stormcall
EffectInfo.description: Using it calls lightning on up to 4 enemies near the target, 350 damage each

Object.Description: Nikao's storm, sealed in sapphire. Raise it and the sky answers. Dropped by the Empowered Nikao the Azure Dragon.

EffectInfo.name: Ignition
EffectInfo.description: Every 3rd hit sets the enemy alight, burning for half the hit over 2 seconds

Object.Description: Forged in Pyyr's own fire the second time he fell. It burns hot enough to scorch its wielder. Dropped by the Empowered Pyyr the Crimson Dragon.

EffectInfo.name: Obsidian Shell
EffectInfo.description: A shell that takes the whole of the next shot, back 8 seconds after it breaks

Object.Description: Plates of Feargus' obsidian scales: heavy, cold, and all but unbreakable. Dropped by the Empowered Feargus the Obsidian Dragon.

EffectInfo.name: Undertow
EffectInfo.description: Using it slows enemies within 3.5 tiles of the target for 3 seconds (its armour shred does the rest)

Object.Description: Thessal's pearl, grown dark in the depths of death. The tide inside it pulls at the world. Dropped by the Empowered Thessal the Mermaid Goddess.

EffectInfo.name: Guardian's Oath
EffectInfo.description: Using it gives everyone within 5 tiles +10 defense for 4 seconds

Object.Description: Bes guarded the tomb for millennia, and then once more. His shield remembers every blow. Dropped by the Empowered Bes.

EffectInfo.name: Starlight
EffectInfo.description: Using it gives everyone within 6 tiles +8 attack for 4 seconds

Object.Description: Nut's book of the stars, its pages the night itself. Its light mends what the dark has broken. Dropped by the Empowered Nut.

EffectInfo.name: Earthshaker
EffectInfo.description: Using it shakes the earth: 400 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles

Object.Description: The earth god's crown, heavy as a mountain. Its wearer fights as if the ground itself were behind them. Dropped by the Empowered Geb.

EffectInfo.name: Wyvern's Fury
EffectInfo.description: Half a second after using it, a second storm strikes the 3 enemies nearest the target for 300 each

Object.Description: Carved from the Ivory Wyvern's horn after its second death. Its lightning leaps further than any mortal's. Dropped by the Empowered Ivory Wyvern.

EffectInfo.name: Blobomb
EffectInfo.description: Using it also throws a Blobomb at the target: 2 seconds later it bursts for 700 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles

Object.Description: A shard of the Sentinel's own stone, still humming with its duty. Nothing crosses where it lies. Dropped by the Empowered Forgotten Sentinel.

EffectInfo.name: Fire and Ice
EffectInfo.description: Each cast takes its turn: fire burns the enemies within 3.5 tiles of the target for 450 over 3 seconds, then ice hits them for 250 and slows them for 3 seconds

Object.Description: The Archmage's last spell, cast as fire and ice consumed him a second time. It has not finished burning, or freezing. Dropped by the Empowered Twilight Archmage.

EffectInfo.name: Forgotten
EffectInfo.description: Using it makes the Realm forget you: for 5 seconds your shots deal a fifth more, ignoring defense

Object.Description: The King's burial shroud, torn off him when he rose. Whoever wears it slips from the Realm's memory, and strikes from there. Dropped by the Empowered Forgotten King.

EffectInfo.name: Bulwark
EffectInfo.description: Below half your health, gives +12 defense for 5 seconds (every 20 seconds at most)

Object.Description: The Sentinel wore this for an age on the bridge. It still braces when its wearer falters. Dropped by the Elder Forgotten Sentinel.

EffectInfo.name: Eclipse
EffectInfo.description: Each enemy you kill restores 15 mana

Object.Description: The Twilight Gemstone after the eclipse: darker, and hungrier. It drinks what its wearer kills. Dropped by the Elder Twilight Archmage.

EffectInfo.name: King's Will
EffectInfo.description: Using your ability gives +8 attack for 3 seconds

Object.Description: The crown of a king somebody finally remembered. It lends its wearer the will of the one who lost it. Dropped by the Elder Forgotten King.

EffectInfo.description: Summon an Eye of Marble for 4.5 seconds

EffectInfo.name: Eye Effect
EffectInfo.description: Armored, Damaging and Healing for 2 seconds (renewed) within 4 squares

EffectInfo.name: Marble Pillars
EffectInfo.description: Using it raises four marble pillars round you for 5 seconds: each second every pillar strikes the enemies within 2.5 tiles of it for 150

Object.Description: The seal that bound the Colossus to its purpose, cracked when it rose a second time. The halls still answer to it. Dropped by the Empowered Marble Colossus.

EffectInfo.name: Pentagram
EffectInfo.description: Using it draws a pentagram on the target: its five points burst one after another for 120 each to enemies within 3 tiles, then its heart erupts for 400, ignoring defense, and curses them for 3 seconds

Object.Description: What was left on the pentagram when Malus' last ritual failed. It remembers the shape of the star. Dropped by the Empowered Malus.

EffectInfo.name: Singularity
EffectInfo.description: Every 10th hit opens a singularity on the enemy for 3 seconds: twice a second it deals 120, ignoring defense, to every enemy within 3 tiles and slows them

Object.Description: Strung with a thread of the Void Entity itself. Where its arrows gather, nothing is allowed to stay. Dropped by the Empowered Void Entity.

EffectInfo.name: Marble Stance
EffectInfo.description: Standing still for 1.5 seconds turns you to marble: armored until you move

Object.Description: A lodestone from the heart of the halls. Whoever carries it stands as the Colossus stood. Dropped by the Elder Marble Colossus.

EffectInfo.name: Blood Pact
EffectInfo.description: Below half your health, your shots deal 15% more, ignoring defense

Object.Description: Malus' cultists each wore one, and each paid for it. The closer its wearer is to death, the more it gives. Dropped by the Elder Malus.

EffectInfo.name: Entropy
EffectInfo.description: Every 5 seconds, breaks the armor of the enemy nearest you within 6 tiles for 2 seconds

Object.Description: A Sourcestone the Void has eaten through. What stands near it starts to come apart. Dropped by the Elder Void Entity.
